definitions.explanation: To make things correspond or fit together.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}を{合|あ}わせましょう。
{二|ふた}つの{材料|ざいりょう}を{合|あ}わせる。
みんなで{力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせて{頑張|がんば}ろう。
examples.english: Let's all combine our efforts and do our best.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}に{合|あ}わせて{踊|おど}る。

notes:
{合|あ}わせる is an ichidan verb meaning to combine, match, or adjust things together.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {合|あ}う (intransitive, to match/fit)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {時計|とけい}を{合|あ}わせる: to set a clock/watch
- {力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせる: to combine efforts
- {目|め}を{合|あ}わせる: to make eye contact
- {予定|よてい}を{合|あ}わせる: to coordinate schedules
- {手|て}を{合|あ}わせる: to put hands together (pray)
- {話|はなし}を{合|あ}わせる: to get stories straight

COMPOUND VERBS:
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire
- {組|く}み{合|あ}わせる: to combine
- {打|う}ち{合|あ}わせる: to discuss (meeting)
